today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Create a space and add your first note. Cards you make from your notes will show up here when they are due.
today.due: {count, plural, one {# card due} other {# cards due}}
today.noneDue: Nothing due. Good time to write notes or add cards.
today.reviewedToday: {count, plural, one {# card reviewed today} other {# cards reviewed today}}

status.degraded: The server is running, but the database is not responding

errors.payloadTooLarge: The note is too large (limit 2 MB).
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

auth.title: Sign in to your Hub
auth.body: Open the one-time link printed in the terminal where the Hub started. Need a new link? Run one of these commands:
auth.invalid: This link is invalid, expired or already used.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try a new link.
auth.error: Sign-in failed. Try a new link.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.intro: A space holds one area you are learning, such as a Holberton project or a track.
spaces.empty: No spaces yet. Create your first one above.

topics.title: Topics
topics.intro: Break the space into concepts you want to be able to explain without help.

notes.exists: A note with this path already exists.
notes.collision: Another note differs only in letter case or accents. Choose a different name.
notes.invalidPath: This file name or folder is not allowed.
notes.conflict: This note changed on disk since you opened it.
notes.readOnly: Hub cannot safely edit this file (unsupported encoding or mixed line endings).
notes.readOnlyLinked: This note is in your linked vault, which the Hub only reads. Edit it in Obsidian; the Hub picks up the change.
notes.vaultUnavailable: The vault this note is in is not available right now.

notesPage.title: Notes
notesPage.intro: Your Markdown notes. They stay plain .md files you can open in Obsidian or any editor.
notesPage.empty: No notes yet. Create one above or put .md files in your vault folder.

editor.label: Edit {title}
editor.hint: Ctrl+S / ⌘S saves. Links like [[Note]] and #tags are picked up automatically.
editor.conflict: This note was changed outside the Hub (for example in Obsidian) after you opened it.
editor.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

cards.title: Cards
cards.intro: Write a question on the front and the answer on the back. Review them when they are due.
cards.frontPlaceholder: e.g. What does fork() return in the child?
cards.fromSelection: Make a card from the selection
cards.inactive: This card is suspended or archived.

review.title: Review
review.emptyBody: New cards are due right away. Make cards from your notes or in a space.
review.finishedBody: {count, plural, one {You reviewed # card.} other {You reviewed # cards.}} Come back when more are due.

backup.title: Backups
backup.intro: A backup holds your database and every file in the Hub vault, checked with hashes. Keep copies somewhere else too. Linked vaults are not included.
backup.failed: Backup failed. Check the server log.
backup.restoreBody: Restore runs from the command line into an empty data folder while the Hub is stopped. Inspect first, then restore:

import.title: Import a Holberton project
import.intro: Turn a project's learning objectives into self-check cards and a project note. The Hub never signs in to the intranet and never reads task solutions.
import.step1: Open the project page on the intranet.
import.step3: Paste it here and press Read page.
import.nothingFound: No learning objectives found. Copy the whole project page and try again.
import.withNote: Also create a project note with resources, objectives and a task checklist
import.import: {count, plural, one {Import with # card} other {Import with # cards}}
import.cardBack: Say it out loud or whiteboard it, then check yourself. Could you explain it to a peer?
import.cardBackWithResources: Say it out loud or whiteboard it, then check yourself. Could you explain it to a peer? Resources: {resources}
import.noteIntro: Imported from the Holberton intranet on {date}. Solutions are yours to write — follow The Framework.
import.noteSkipped: The project note could not be created with this name. You can create it yourself on the Notes page.

archive.topicsSummary: {count, plural, one {# archived topic} other {# archived topics}}

quizzes.title: Quizzes
quizzes.intro: Check yourself on a topic. Practice shows the answer after each question; exam shows nothing until you submit.
quizzes.needTopic: Add a topic first: every quiz belongs to one.
quizzes.archivedNote: This quiz is archived. Its attempts are kept.
quizzes.tooManyQuestions: A quiz can have at most 100 questions.
quizzes.noQuestions: Add at least one question before starting.
quizzes.needQuestions: Add at least one question below to start.
quizzes.locked: This answer is already checked and cannot change.
quizzes.notGradable: Only an answered short question can be graded.
quizzes.notRevealed: Submit the exam before grading short answers.
quizzes.referenceHint: You compare your answer with this one and decide if you got it.

modeHint.practice: See the answer after each question.
modeHint.exam: Answers stay hidden until you submit.

quizzes.confidenceQuestion: How sure are you about this topic right now?
quizzes.ungraded: {count, plural, one {# not graded} other {# not graded}}
quizzes.examNote: Exam mode: your answers are saved as you go and you can change them until you submit.
quizzes.notAnswered: You did not answer this one.
quizzes.unansweredWarning: {count, plural, one {# question has no answer yet.} other {# questions have no answer yet.}}
quizzes.calibration: Before you started you said: {label} ({n} of 5). Compare that with the result above.
quizzes.calibrationSkipped: You skipped the confidence question for this attempt.
quizzes.signalNote: One attempt is a signal, not a measurement. A few more attempts over time tell you more.

anki.title: Export cards to Anki
anki.intro: A plain text file for Anki 2.1.54 or newer (File → Import). Each space and topic becomes a sub-deck under “Holberton Hub”. Review history stays in the Hub.

vaultImport.title: Import notes
vaultImport.intro: Copy Markdown notes from a zip (for example an exported Obsidian vault) into the Hub vault. You see what will happen before anything is written, and existing notes are never overwritten. Attachments are not imported yet.
vaultImport.prefixPlaceholder: Imported/<name of the zip or folder>
vaultImport.willImport: {count, plural, one {# note will be copied into {prefix}.} other {# notes will be copied into {prefix}.}}
vaultImport.readOnly: {count, plural, one {# of them is opened read-only (not valid UTF-8 or mixed line endings).} other {# of them are opened read-only (not valid UTF-8 or mixed line endings).}}
vaultImport.interrupted: The last import stopped part way. Import again to finish it; notes already copied are kept.
vaultImport.linkWarning: Links that start at the vault root, like [[Folder/Note]], may stop resolving because the notes now sit inside the import folder. Links by note name keep working.
vaultImport.done: {created, plural, one {# note imported into {prefix}.} other {# notes imported into {prefix}.}}
vaultImport.doneExists: {count, plural, one {# was skipped because a note already exists there.} other {# were skipped because notes already exist there.}}
vaultImport.doneFailed: {count, plural, one {# could not be written. Check the server log.} other {# could not be written. Check the server log.}}
vaultImport.failed: The import failed. Check the server log.
vaultImport.bad_archive: This file is not a zip the Hub can read safely (damaged, or it contains unsafe paths).
vaultImport.too_many_entries: The zip has more than 20,000 entries.
vaultImport.too_large_total: The Markdown files add up to more than 500 MB.
vaultImport.upload_too_large: The zip is larger than 100 MB.
vaultImport.bad_prefix: That folder name is not allowed in the vault.
vaultImport.too_many_pending: Three previews are already open. Import or discard one first.

reason.not_markdown: {count, plural, one {# file that is not Markdown (attachments come later)} other {# files that are not Markdown (attachments come later)}}
reason.hidden: {count, plural, one {# hidden or app file (.obsidian, .git …)} other {# hidden or app files (.obsidian, .git …)}}
reason.invalid_path: {count, plural, one {# with a name the vault does not allow} other {# with names the vault does not allow}}
reason.too_large: {count, plural, one {# larger than 2 MB} other {# larger than 2 MB}}
reason.symlink: {count, plural, one {# symbolic link} other {# symbolic links}}
reason.special_file: {count, plural, one {# special file} other {# special files}}
reason.encrypted: {count, plural, one {# encrypted file} other {# encrypted files}}
reason.unsupported: {count, plural, one {# file compressed in a format the Hub cannot read} other {# files compressed in a format the Hub cannot read}}
reason.collision_in_source: {count, plural, one {# that clashes with another file in the import (same name apart from case, or a file where a folder is)} other {# that clash with each other (same name apart from case, or a file where a folder is)}}
reason.exists: {count, plural, one {# where a note already exists} other {# where notes already exist}}
reason.missing_note: {count, plural, one {# where a deleted note's cards and history still live} other {# where deleted notes' cards and history still live}}

linkedVault.title: Linked vault
linkedVault.intro: An existing vault the Hub reads but never changes. Its notes appear in Notes and search, and you can make cards from them. Edit them in Obsidian.
linkedVault.notes: {count, plural, one {# note indexed.} other {# notes indexed.}}

state.unavailable: The folder is not available right now (is the drive or mount connected?). Its notes, cards and history are kept.
state.replaced: A different folder is mounted than the one these notes came from. Nothing was changed. If you moved the vault on purpose, confirm it below.
state.empty_unconfirmed: The folder has no Markdown files. Nothing was marked as deleted, in case the mount is missing. If you emptied the vault on purpose, confirm it below.

linkedVault.rebindHelp: Notes keep their cards where the same path still exists; notes that are gone are marked missing.

goals.title: Goals
goals.intro: What you want to reach in this space, what done means for you, and the steps. Progress counts completed tasks; it does not measure how well you know the topic.
goals.goalTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Finish the simple shell project
goals.criteriaPlaceholder: e.g. all checker tasks pass and I can explain fork/exec without notes
goals.progress: {done} of {total, plural, one {# task completed} other {# tasks completed}}
goals.archived: This goal is archived. Restore it to change its tasks.
goals.tooManyTasks: A goal can have at most 100 tasks.

noteTopics.title: Topics
noteTopics.spaceIntro: Notes linked to this space's topics. Link a note from the note's sidebar; the file itself is not changed.

sessions.heading: Study session
sessions.running: Started at {time} · {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
sessions.reflectIntro: Session finished: {objective}. Three short notes, all optional.
sessions.objective: What do you want to do? (optional)
sessions.objectivePlaceholder: e.g. understand how fork() copies a process
sessions.badRef: That space or task does not exist.

ai.title: AI
ai.intro: Optional. The Hub works fully without AI. When you turn it on, you choose where requests go: a model on your own machine (Ollama, LM Studio) or a cloud service with your own key.
ai.keyOptional: API key (if the server needs one)
ai.keyStored: Key saved ({mask}). Type a new one to replace it.
ai.keyEncrypted: Saved encrypted on this server (HUB_SECRET_KEY is set). It is never shown again and is not in backups.
ai.keyPlain: Saved on this server without encryption, readable by anyone with access to the data folder. Set HUB_SECRET_KEY to encrypt it. It is never shown again and is not in backups.
ai.remoteNote: Requests to this provider leave your machine. Only what an AI feature sends goes there, and each feature asks before sending your notes.
ai.notReady: Not ready: fill in the model, and the key if the provider needs one.
ai.testNote: The test sends three tiny fixed prompts. With a cloud provider this is a paid request; a local model may take a while to load.

error.schema_invalid: answer did not match the format

ai.conflict: These settings were changed elsewhere. The form now shows the latest version.
ai.busy: A test is already running or just ran. Try again in a few seconds.

invalid.invalid_url: That address is not a valid URL.
invalid.bad_scheme: The address must start with http:// or https://.
invalid.credentials_in_url: Put the key in the key field, not in the address.
invalid.query_not_allowed: The address must not contain ? or #.

tutor.examMode: AI is paused during exam mode. You can end exam mode early.
tutor.conflict: This thread or request cannot be changed right now.
tutor.busy: A response is already being generated in this thread.
tutor.hintsRequired: Complete three hints before drafting a question for a peer.
tutor.title: Framework tutor
tutor.frameworkIntro: Three short notes about where you are stuck. Leave any field blank, or skip if you have already done this.

frameworkFields.rephrase: The problem in your own words

modeHelp.project: Hints and questions to help you work through the task; no task solutions.
modeHelp.explain: Full explanations, examples and questions for personal learning.

tutor.peerIntro: Write what you tried yourself. This draft uses your words and the suggestions you received, without AI.
tutor.select: Text selected. Use your keyboard or context menu to copy.
tutor.aiOff: AI is off. Turn it on in Settings to use the tutor.
tutor.aiNotReady: AI is not ready. Finish setting up your provider and model to use the tutor.
tutor.remote: Your messages, the topic and your Framework answers are sent to {provider}. No notes are sent.

error.unreachable: Could not reach the model server.
error.auth: The provider refused the API key.
error.rate_limited: The provider is busy. Try again later.
error.context_overflow: This conversation is too long for the model.
error.schema_invalid: The model returned an unexpected answer format.
error.timeout: The response timed out. You can try again.
error.capability_missing: This model does not support the requested feature.
error.unknown: The response failed. Please try again.
error.exam_mode: AI is paused during exam mode.
error.interrupted: The response was interrupted. You can try again.
error.not_ready: AI is not ready. Check Settings → AI.
error.archived: This thread or space is archived. Restore it to continue.
error.not_found: This thread or space could not be found.
error.validation_failed: Check the fields and try again.
error.payload_conflict: This request was already sent with different content. Send a new message.
error.busy: A response is already being generated in this thread.
error.hints_required: Complete three hints before drafting a question for a peer.

actionText.approach: Let's do the next step of approaching the project.

exam.title: Exam mode
exam.intro: Pause all AI while you work independently. You can end this voluntary mode early.
exam.banner: Exam mode until {time} — AI is off
